error.HEADLESS_CLI_UNAVAILABLE: The Claude CLI for the subscription Brain was not found at the connected path, or it moved (for example after a Node.js or CLI reinstall). Nothing was sent to a model and no other model was chosen. Connect the subscription Brain again with the new path.
error.HEADLESS_OWNER_MISMATCH: The subscription Brain belongs to another operating-system user. A process may use only its own person's Claude login; nothing was started and no other model was chosen.
error.HEADLESS_PREFLIGHT_FAILED: The subscription Brain's check before use failed, so the channel stays closed. No model was called and no other model was chosen; the check runs again on the next call.
error.HEADLESS_PREFLIGHT_FAILED.version: The installed Claude CLI version is older than this model needs, or its version could not be read. The channel stays closed; no model was called and no other model was chosen. Update the CLI, then try again.
error.HEADLESS_PREFLIGHT_FAILED.flags: The installed Claude CLI does not offer every option the subscription Brain needs (for example the restricted, tool-less mode). The channel stays closed; no model was called and no other model was chosen.
error.HEADLESS_PREFLIGHT_FAILED.auth-sta: The Claude CLI did not report its login state in a readable form. The channel stays closed; no model was called and no other model was chosen.
error.HEADLESS_PREFLIGHT_FAILED.config-d: The Claude CLI reports a different login directory than the connected one, or that directory is not yours. The channel stays closed; no model was called and no other model was chosen.
error.HEADLESS_PREFLIGHT_FAILED.state-di: Deckent's private working directory for the subscription Brain is not private to you (owner or permissions). The channel stays closed; no model was called.
error.HEADLESS_PREFLIGHT_FAILED.spawn: The Claude CLI did not finish its check in time or could not be started. The channel stays closed; no model was called and no other model was chosen.
error.HEADLESS_LOGIN_REQUIRED: The Claude CLI is not signed in with a Claude subscription (claude.ai) in the Brain's login directory. Sign it in with `deckent models login --connection claude-cli-subscription` (the CLI's own sign-in, in your terminal); Deckent never opens or reads the login. Nothing was sent and no other model was chosen.
error.HEADLESS_REQUEST_INVALID: This request cannot run as one tool-less subscription Brain turn (it needs exactly one instruction and one message, the pinned model and a supported effort). Nothing was sent.
error.HEADLESS_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE: The subscription Brain runs the Claude CLI only inside Deckent's process isolation (bubblewrap), and no usable bubblewrap was found on this machine (or it changed since the service measured it). Nothing was started, no model was called and no other model was chosen. `deckent doctor` shows the sandbox state; restart the service after installing or fixing bubblewrap.
error.HEADLESS_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE.use: The subscription Brain runs the Claude CLI only inside Deckent's process isolation, and this kernel does not let bubblewrap create the user namespace it needs (for example an AppArmor restriction). Nothing was started, no model was called and no other model was chosen. `deckent doctor` names the fix.
error.HEADLESS_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE.rea: The isolated process for the subscription Brain could not be set up, so the Claude CLI did not start. Nothing was sent, no model was called and no other model was chosen; the check runs again on the next call.
error.HEADLESS_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE.gat: The network gateway of the isolated subscription Brain could not be opened, so the Claude CLI did not start. Nothing was sent, no model was called and no other model was chosen; the check runs again on the next call.
error.HEADLESS_DELEGATION_REFUSED: This subscription Brain is connected for its owner only: an AI or MCP actor, or a background role (recovery decision, memory evaluator), may use it only after the owner's explicit consent on the connection. Nothing was sent and no other model was chosen. The owner can give or withdraw the consent with `deckent models connect --connection claude-cli-subscription --scope <scope> --model <model> --command-id <id> --delegate ai,system` (or `--delegate none`).
error.HEADLESS_PERSON_REQUIRED: Only the person who owns the Claude login can connect the subscription Brain or change its consent; an AI or MCP actor cannot. Nothing was changed.
error.HEADLESS_GUARD_FAILED: The Claude CLI started differently than allowed ({field}), so it was stopped before using the result. Nothing was accepted and no other model was chosen; the channel check runs again on the next call.
error.HEADLESS_CREDITS_REQUIRED: The Claude subscription asks for extra credits for this request. Deckent never buys usage: nothing was accepted and no other model was chosen. Decide in your Claude account, then try again.
error.HEADLESS_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: The Claude subscription's usage limit is reached, so this step did not run. No other model was chosen and nothing is retried on its own; send a new request after the reset.

headless.help.connect:
Subscription Brain (claude-cli-subscription, owner only): no key and no address; the connected
CLI uses the Brain's own Claude login and runs isolated (bubblewrap: only its login dir, no other
files, network to the provider only). [--executable <abs path>] (default: first in PATH)
[--config-dir <abs dir>] (default: the Brain's own login dir, signed in by `deckent models login`;
another dir only when you name it) [--delegate none|ai|system|ai,system] (who besides you may use
it; absent keeps your earlier choice). Without usable bubblewrap it is refused.

error.HEADLESS_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE.lim: The isolated subscription Brain could not set its process limits (CPU time, memory, process count): the limiter (util-linux prlimit) is missing or did not apply them, so the Claude CLI did not start. Nothing was sent, no model was called and no other model was chosen. Install util-linux; the check runs again on the next call.
error.HEADLESS_LIMIT_REACHED: The isolated Claude CLI reached one of its process limits and was stopped. Nothing was accepted, nothing is retried on its own and no other model was chosen.
error.HEADLESS_LIMIT_REACHED.cpu-time: The isolated Claude CLI used up its CPU time limit for one turn and was stopped. Nothing was accepted, nothing is retried on its own and no other model was chosen; the turn may already count against the subscription.
error.HEADLESS_LIMIT_REACHED.processes: The isolated Claude CLI tried to start more processes or threads than its limit allows and stopped. Nothing was accepted, nothing is retried on its own and no other model was chosen; the turn may already count against the subscription.
error.HEADLESS_LIMIT_REACHED.memory: The isolated Claude CLI ran out of its memory limit and stopped. Nothing was accepted, nothing is retried on its own and no other model was chosen; the turn may already count against the subscription.
error.HEADLESS_LOGIN_BUSY: Another subscription Brain call is using the same Claude login right now, and it did not finish within the wait. Nothing was sent, no model was called and no other model was chosen; send the request again.
error.HEADLESS_LOGIN_BUSY.cli: Your own Claude CLI is renewing its login (its refresh lock is in the login directory), so the subscription Brain did not start beside it. Nothing was sent, no model was called and no other model was chosen; try again in a moment. If this stays while no Claude session runs, a crashed session may have left its refresh lock behind: Deckent never opens or removes files in the login directory, so remove that lock yourself.
headless.help.action.login: Sign in to a subscription: Claude CLI or ChatGPT (your terminal)
headless.help.login:
Usage: deckent models login --connection claude-cli-subscription [--sso]
         [--config-dir <abs dir>] [--executable <abs path>] [--lang <locale>]
       deckent models login --connection chatgpt-login --scope <id>
         [--connection-id <id>] [--new-account]
claude-cli-subscription signs the subscription Brain's own Claude login in: the Claude CLI's own sign-in runs in this terminal (it may open your browser; Deckent captures nothing it shows and never sees the token). The login lives in Deckent's state (`deckent paths`: headlessLogins), 0700, never in a backup and never read by Deckent; your own ~/.claude is not used. To switch account (for example Max or Team), sign in again here. --sso forces the SSO sign-in; --config-dir signs a dir you name instead. Then: deckent models connect --connection claude-cli-subscription ... (without --config-dir it uses this login; a connection on another dir keeps working until you connect again).
chatgpt-login opens the ChatGPT sign-in in your browser and always prints the sign-in link, so you can open it yourself; Esc or Ctrl+C cancels the wait.
Only you, at a real terminal: an AI tool, MCP, CI, a pipe or --json is refused.
headless.login.card.title: Sign the Brain in to Claude?
headless.login.card.what: The Claude CLI's own sign-in starts in this terminal: it opens your browser (or prints a link to open on any device) and finishes by itself as soon as you sign in there, without another key press here. Deckent captures nothing it shows and never sees the token. To switch account (Max, Team), sign in again.
